title: Fabulas mitologicas del Siglo de Oro (ed. Antonio Rojas Castro, GitHub)
notes: Antonio Rojas Castro's 2016 TEI-XML corpus of 26 Spanish Golden Age mythological fables (~150k words, CC BY 4.0), included here with witnesses Barahona de Soto's Acteón and Vértumno, Bermúdez's Narciso, Bocángel's Leandro, Carrillo's Acis; the repo (live 200) is the canonical public source, with a companion publication in Studia Aurea (2017) and stylometry workshops built on this corpus. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.06 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
institution: Antonio Rojas Castro (Freie Universitaet Berlin / UNED)
